compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of an exercise app, specifically within the "Exercises" section. The screen displays a filter menu titled "FILTER - Difficulty," which allows users to filter exercises based on their difficulty level. The options available for selection are:

1. Beginner
2. Intermediate
3. Advanced

Users can select or deselect these options by tapping the checkboxes next to each difficulty level. There are also two buttons at the bottom of the filter menu: "CANCEL" to exit the filter menu without applying any changes, and "FILTER" to apply the selected filters. Additionally, there are "Select All" and "Clear All" options at the top of the filter menu to quickly select or deselect all difficulty levels.
